posts.headline: One Nut Barner is now twenty-one straight editions into total radio silence, and a 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings is officially the longest-running non-answer in league history.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra has the best winning percentage AND the best average finish in the entire league at .714 and 1.5, yet somehow still owns nothing shiny — that's peak Cowboys energy, all résumé, no trophy.

posts.headline: The fluke jury on Big Head's title has been in session for six straight editions, and preseason is almost over — Sasinci's World is about to run out of offseason to hide behind.
posts.detail: A 13-15 career record propping up a championship banner is still the strangest math in this league, and the Milk Man himself has offered zero rebuttal, just more threats to quit.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is about to draft from a 4-10, dead-last, 12th-place foundation, and the untalented tenth nickname has never felt more like a prophecy than a punchline.
posts.detail: With an average finish of literal 12th and a .286 win pct, this is the bottom-feeder's bottom-feeder — expectations aren't low, they're subterranean.

posts.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin is entering another draft with the same cursed instincts that once led him to take a DEFENSIVE player first overall, and a 13-14-1 record says the plagues aren't done yet.
posts.detail: BIBLE OR THE BELT has a 5.5 average finish across two seasons — Eli keeps asking the league whether they want the Bible or the Belt, but his own roster history says he can't even choose the right pick.

posts.kicker: PRINCE OF PERSIA, THE SEQUEL NOBODY WANTS
posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh is walking into another draft still carrying an 11th-place, 5-9 debut season, and this league has zero faith a new roster changes the ending.
posts.detail: A .357 win pct and dead-last-adjacent finish means Prince of Persia needs more than a good draft board — he needs a miracle, and preseason hype doesn't count as one.
